instruction.text: This map shows the rainforests around the world. What do you notice about their location?
instruction.sound: This map shows the reinforests around the world. What do you notice about their location?

b: They are all in the Southern Hemisphere.

feedback.end: Tropical rainforests are located close to the Equator, where the energy from the Sun is more concentrated. This affects the climate in the rainforests.

instruction.text: What do you think the climate is like in the rainforest?

b.sound: hot and wet for most of the year
freezing temperatures and snow all year round

feedback.end: These hot and wet conditions make the rainforest extremely humid. Rainforests have a tropical climate.

instruction.text: The rainforest has four layers. Select each layer to find out more.

feedback.end: Here, tall trees grow up to 60 metres. The animals in this layer are mostly ones that can fly, like birds and butterflies.
The canopy is a more sheltered, leafy layer of tree tops with lots of fruit. It is also home to most rainforest wildlife, including monkeys and sloths.
The understorey is shady and cooler. This level is home to many animals, such as snakes and jaguars.
The forest floor is very dark and humid. Animals such as poisonous frogs and creepy crawlies are found here.

instruction.text: Drag the rainforest to Costa Rica to find out more.

feedback.end: Costa Rica is a country in Central America that is covered in rainforests. In fact, they take up 51% of the land!

atoms.b: Over 100 species of trees can be found in these rainforests, as well as hundreds of different ((deserts ++animals)), such as howler monkeys and American crocodiles.
The rainforests in Costa Rica have slightly different ((buildings ++climates)) depending on where they are in the country.
For example, the rainforests in the centre of the country are more humid with higher ((distances ++temperatures)), whereas those found on the northern coast have ((higher ++cooler)) temperatures.

instruction.text: The rainforest is abundant in resources. Complete the sentences to learn how humans use them.

atoms.a: Bananas, chocolate and tea come from ...
atoms.b: trees in the rainforest or grow in farms in this warm climate.
atoms.sound: Bananas, chocolate and tea come from trees in the rainforest or grow in farms in this warm climate.

atoms.b: used to make medicines to treat illnesses.
atoms.sound: Many rainforest plants can be used to make medicines to treat illnesses.

atoms.a: Humans use wood from the trees to make ...
atoms.b: many everyday materials, such as paper.
atoms.sound: Humans use wood from the trees to make many everyday materials, such as paper.

instruction.text: However, extracting these resources leads to deforestation. What do you think deforestation is?

b: ++cutting down many trees in a large area
planting too many trees in one place

feedback.end: Deforestation is destroying the rainforest. More and more trees are getting cut down for resources or to make space for farming. It has led to some animals becoming endangered.
